refusal.device_layout: uint32 slots, one slot per source_id
refusal.scheduler: zero all slots before launch; if any is nonzero, discard the entire gradient and create the host failure record for that source_id

workspace.tangent: 32*(nlev+1)*ncells bytes; 16-byte AcousticDual records with float64 internal directional values
workspace.adjoint_tape: 6144*(512*(nlev+1)+256) bytes; 128 independent thread tapes with float64 weights and bars
workspace.adjoint_contributions: 8*(8*(nlev+1)+1)*ncells bytes, one private segment per column
workspace.lifetime: one derivative launch; no persistent tape

alias: Primal fields follow the captured forward aliases. Incoming output-seed buffers are writable and disjoint from all outgoing input-cotangent buffers, other fields, workspace and failure buffers; the entry clears exactly the forward-overwritten indices after consuming their seeds. rw and rw_save may share the identical captured primal allocation in column_solve, and their input cotangents share it.
helper: hex-ad/cuda/acoustic/acoustic_mpas_fp32.cuh is the exact pinned CUDA_FTZ_HELPERS source; acoustic_coefficients_tape.cuh supplies the shared precise tangent and reverse tape while primal operations remain float32.

g6_inactive.why: fixed mesh constant: inactive (zero tangent in, cotangent discarded), GAPS G6
fixed mesh constant: inactive (zero tangent in, cotangent discarded), GAPS G6
fixed mesh constant: inactive (zero tangent in, cotangent discarded), GAPS G6

launch_abi.l4_speed: ad/window-L4-speed: reverse entries ['l4_cells', 'l4_reduce'] replace the reference single reverse entry; tangent unchanged; see phys/l4speed/README.md

cotangent_reduction: Repeated reads and shared inputs accumulate in fixed order in float64; each float32 cotangent is rounded once on its final write (COMMON-AD section 40). Internal tangent arithmetic and reverse tape weights use float64 to reduce cancellation; exposed shadows remain float32. Output seeds are separate writable buffers; the reverse consumes each overwritten slot and leaves untouched seed slots unchanged.
